purpose: Fresh same-host comparison of original P0 edit prompt and verbatim preregistered R57 P1 prompt, both Native; one development source, not timing-method evidence.

source_event_annotations: No manually selected events. Full 90 input frames; score each source valid prefix and remove fixed spatial padding.
